definitions.full: H8648. teren תֶּ֫רַח proper name 1. masculine father of Abraham : (a kind of ibex (compare Assyrian turdâ—u , Arabic Nö ZMG xxxlii (1879), 331 , Syriac capra cauca-sica ), but against this Nö ZMG xl (1886), 167 ; proper name, of divinity Jen ZA vi. 70 ); — ׳ת Gen 11:25-26 , 27 (twice in verse); 11:28 , 31 , 32 (twice in verse); Josh 24:2 ; תָּ֑רַת Gen 11:24 ; 1Chr 1:26 ; Θαρρα , ᵐ5 L Θαρα . — See Selbie Hast. DB TERAH. 2. location station on Exodus Journey Num 33:27-28 , Ταραθ . תִּרְחֲנָה see רחן . תַּרְמִית תרמות, תָּרְמָה, see [II. רמת ]. [ תְּרֵין ] noun masculine , תַּרְתֵּין (K § 65, Anm. 1 ) feminine , two (so in Aramaic dialects Generally (note Nabataean feminine תרתין over against Palmyrene תרתן Lzb 388 ); see Philippi ZMG xxxii (1878), 21 ff. ; adjective according to M § 89 b ); — masculine only construct in עֲשַׂר תִּרֵי twelve , after noun masculine plural Dan 4:26 ; Ezra 6:17 ; feminine after noun feminine plural וְת שִׁתִּין ׳שְׁנִין Dan 6:1 years sixty and two ; = ordinal, תַּרְתֵּין שְׁנַת 4:24 second year .
